scope: Version-aware advanced inference chapter with original diagram and explicit toy/derived claims.

claims.claim: ColumnParallelLinear partitions output features while RowParallelLinear partitions input features and reduces partial outputs when reduction is enabled.
vLLM exposes model-parallel process groups and tensor-parallel collectives; model replicas with TP must coordinate ranks to execute one logical request.
Official guidance recommends evaluating tensor parallelism within a multi-GPU node and tensor plus pipeline parallelism for models spanning nodes.
claims.locator: Distributed inference strategies for a single-model replica

claims.claim: High-bandwidth GPU-to-GPU and inter-node networking matter to TP performance and collective overhead.
claims.locator: Optimizing network communication for tensor parallelism

claims.claim: The article's column/row split and simplified GEMM communication equations are matrix algebra illustrations, not a vLLM kernel trace.
claims.notes: Shape H and intermediate 4H are teaching examples, not universal model shapes.

claims.claim: The 2(p−1)S/p per-rank ring all-reduce transfer estimate is a simplified bandwidth model, not a latency or kernel guarantee.
claims.notes: Ignored topology, protocol, scale, synchronization and bandwidth/latency variations.
